article.title: NVIDIA CUDA-X Libraries Give Agents the Tools to Accelerate Scientific Discovery
article.excerpt: With expanded NVIDIA CUDA-X libraries, including cuPhoton, cuPotential and cuSpa, researchers can sift through vast amounts of data to accelerate research, from astrophysics and materials science to single-cell biology. The speedups are helping scientists analyze larger datasets and model more complex systems. The new libraries give AI agents the tools to help researchers make discoveries

fa.title: کتابخانه های NVIDIA CUDA-X ابزار را برای تسریع کشف علمی ارائه می دهند
